complete_examples.text: Based on the principle of linear superposition, an improved cycle algorithm adapted to train-track-infrastructure is proposed.

In order to solve the problem of low efficiency of train-track-tunnel dynamic system, this paper uses linear superposition method to decompose train-track system into vehicle-track system on the basis of cyclic calculation method, and combines Green function method to put forward an efficient solution of train-track-tunnel dy namic model.
